national.fact: First 11 days of Festive 2025: over Rs 60,000 cr online GMV (~3.5x normal), up 20-22% YoY; ~90 million shoppers spending ~Rs 7,000 each.
Tier-2+ cities were 60-65% of festive shoppers; smartphones and appliances were 60-65% of GMV.
Diwali 2025 season: orders +24%, GMV +23%; tier-2 and tier-3 ~55% of orders; quick commerce +120%.
Amazon Great Indian Festival 2025: 276 crore visits, 70% from tier-2/3; festive lights and decor +500%, lab-grown diamonds +390%, two-wheelers +105%.
Meesho festive sale 2025: ~74% of demand from tier-2/3; 29,000 orders a minute; top categories fashion, beauty, electronics, home decor.
Diwali 2025 trade (online + offline) hit a record Rs 6.05 lakh cr: grocery 12%, gold 10%, electronics 8%, gifts 7%, sweets 5%, puja 3%.
Meesho: voice search +40% YoY and vernacular use +162%; ~80% of 250M+ users from tier-2 and beyond.
Haryana is 11th by order volume but 3rd by order value; Bihar 10th by volume but 15th by value.

festival.fact: Onam window: Rs 22-25k cr consumer spend in Kerala; retail 30-40% above normal months; ad spend +10-15%.

Navratri 2025 D2C: beauty 27.8% and fashion 27.7% of orders; D2C +25% YoY; Maharashtra and Karnataka strongest (GoKwik).
